topic: how to pay credit card bill on chase app
slug: how to pay credit card bill on chase app

steps.narration: Open the Chase app and sign in.
Tap your Freedom Unlimited credit card on the home screen.
Choose how much to pay: current balance, statement balance, or another amount.
Choose the account to pay from under "Pay from".
Choose the payment date under "Pay on", then tap "Continue".
Review the payment details on the "Does everything look OK?" screen and tap "Schedule payment".
The confirmation screen shows your payment has been scheduled.
